title: An Example test
hints: An Example is a test whose "assertion" is its printed output. It only catches a bug if one of the printed lines changes. So choose sizes where a wrong base, a missing decimal or a missing unit would print something different.

Print sizes at the edges: `1000` and `1023` (still bytes), `1024` (the first KiB), `1536` (needs the decimal), and one value in each of MiB, GiB and TiB. Write the `// Output:` comment last, one `// ` line per printed line.
